labels.name: kind/more-info-needed
labels.rationale: The bug report is missing required sections: system information, Prometheus version, and configuration. These are necessary to reproduce the issue.

items.body:
To help reproduce this issue, could you provide the following missing information?

- System information (OS, architecture, etc.)
- Prometheus version
- Prometheus configuration file

This will help the maintainers understand and investigate the problem more effectively. Thank you!
